verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird's Tech and Digital Solutions page names specific AI tools used in client service: a Generative AI legal assistant built with Legora, Luminance AI-assisted document review, and its own 'Evaluate' tool for automating review of bidder responses. The firm also publishes its own free client-facing automation products (SCC Generator and German Term Sheet Generator on Contract Express), though these are document automation rather than AI. The AI descriptions are one-line summaries rather than detailed disclosures. Missing for 10: a published AI-use or governance policy (data handling, human oversight), substantive detail on how the Legora assistant and Luminance are deployed for clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
